free_tier.correction: false; REST API access is Starter-only, and Starter provides a 15-day trial rather than a permanent free tier

description.correction: HiveMQ Cloud is a managed MQTT platform whose REST API manages cluster-scoped MQTT credentials, roles, permissions, clients, and broker metrics. The current REST reference does not document provisioning, creating, or listing Cloud clusters.

notes: The REST API remains operational, but the entry mixes it with unsupported account-level cluster management. HiveMQ changed the preferred API host in May 2025, the submitted documentation path is obsolete, and /v1/clusters is absent from the current reference. Documented routes use /api/v2/orgs/{orgId}/clusters/{clusterId}/.... No authoritative REST rate-limit or CORS policy was located.
